body.contents: Season 1 opens Saturday 6 February at 5 PM Pacific (8 PM Eastern). Spawn and the market open, the border is 6,000 blocks wide, and the End stays closed until Dragon Night. Everyone starts with 10 hearts and 3 hours of newbie protection.
Season 1 ends with the finale on Saturday 10 April.
Next week: King of the Hill I, Saturday 13 February.
Every event is in the Discord's events list: press Interested there for a reminder. New challenges every Monday.
